title: Full UI Tailwind migration and GitHub full-system UAT expansion
businessRules: Presentation migration must not create duplicate business workflows or move authority from API/server guards into the client.

Admin, POS, Storefront, and Employee Portal must use one Tailwind-based visual foundation with Lucide icons, responsive no-horizontal-page-overflow behavior, clear tenant/company/branch context, and progressive disclosure.

GitHub UAT must remain fail-closed and must test exact built artifacts, PostgreSQL runtime, tenant isolation, permissions, idempotency, worker/report flows, provider adapters, browser geometry, and documented operator scenarios.

External provider tests must never print or persist credentials; Telegram and WhatsApp require deterministic CI provider simulation, while optional live probes may run only when protected environment secrets are configured.
Human UAT remains separate from automated GitHub PASS and cannot be auto-approved.
acceptanceCriteria: Legacy hand-written application styling for all four user-facing apps is replaced by Tailwind CSS v4/PostCSS foundation; no decorative gradients, emoji UI icons, forced page horizontal scrolling, or duplicate Admin navigation layers remain.

Admin information architecture makes Company/Tenant, Branch/Warehouse, Users/Roles, Notifications/Telegram/WhatsApp, Automation/Reports, and AI/Forecasting discoverable from explicit operator workspaces.
POS primary sale flow fits common desktop and tablet viewports without horizontal page scrolling and keeps checkout/cart actions immediately visible.

GitHub Full System Simulation runs expanded API, browser, provider-adapter, UI-interaction/geometry, tenant/security, worker, reporting, migration, staging, load/index, and DR gates and uploads machine-readable evidence/screenshots.
Automated workflow fails when an uncovered critical API/operator flow/provider contract is detected; it does not convert Human Stage-20 to PASS.
Repository workflow validation, TypeScript lint, dependency-free regression, database smoke, six-app build, local candidate gate, and GitHub simulation configuration validation remain PASS.
testPlan: Run repository-wide static audit mapping docs/modules/routes/controllers/buttons/navigation/provider flows and store source-bound evidence.
Run Tailwind/UI regression tests forbidding legacy gradients, page-level horizontal overflow, duplicate nav rails, emoji action icons, and requiring Tailwind/PostCSS in all four apps.
Run TypeScript lint and six-app production build after Tailwind migration.
Run PostgreSQL migration rehearsal and database smoke unchanged.
Run API inventory/contract sweep against live exact runtime, including authentication, tenant denial, permission denial, idempotency/replay and representative mutation lifecycle tests.
Run GitHub provider adapter simulation for Telegram and generic WhatsApp HTTP with local deterministic mock server, retry/error/status evidence and secret redaction.

Run built-browser desktop/tablet/mobile matrix checking overlap, viewport overflow, uncaught errors, navigation reachability, forms/buttons for critical operator workflows, and screenshots on failure.
Run worker/report job probe, staging certification, load/index profile, backup/restore DR rehearsal, and automated Stage-20 while Human UAT remains pending.
migrationPlan: No database schema change is planned. Tailwind/PostCSS and CI/UAT changes are source/build tooling only; existing expand-only database migration chain remains unchanged and must still be rehearsed.
rollbackPlan: Revert this work item commit set to the last source-bound automated-GitHub-PASS commit. No database rollback is required because schema is unchanged. If the new UAT gate itself is defective, fix the gate while preserving or strengthening its assertions; never bypass it to release.
monitoringPlan: GitHub job summary and uploaded source-bound evidence will report API coverage, browser viewport coverage, provider simulation results, exact artifact identity, worker/report probe, staging/load/index/DR and Stage-20 automated state. UI regressions are additionally checked by local candidate gate before push.
securityNotes: All runtime identity continues to come from authenticated server context. CI uses non-production PostgreSQL and synthetic provider endpoints. GitHub secrets/environment secrets are never echoed, browser/localStorage evidence is sanitized, provider mocks validate headers/payloads without storing real tokens, and Human Stage-20 remains separately approved.
